summary: Iteration_7 smoke tests for ChaosKey+ M3. Verified backend health, all 6 nav tabs render, Pool tab wallet panel and NO WALLETS DETECTED empty state present, WHAT STAYS VISIBLE panel present, topbar-wallet visible. No JS/React errors introduced by the PrivacyScreen runAction refactor. Real wallet flows (shield/transfer/unshield) not exercisable in sandbox (no Ready extension).
critical_code_review_comments: PrivacyScreen.jsx runAction success-branch is clean and safely swallows balance-refresh errors. Balance refresh gate uses truthy `balance` object as opt-in signal — works but slightly implicit; a named `balanceRevealed` flag would be clearer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_7 is a polish iteration for STRK20 Pool tab: runAction() clears inputs on success and silently refreshes balance if opted-in. All previous smoke tests still green. Backend /api/status, /api/pubkey, /api/ledger return 200. Real wallet actions require browser extension and are out of sandbox scope.
